temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl appears stressed and overwhelmed by the paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help and says it would be amazing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria did not yet know how overwhelmed Cheryl was by this project or whether Cheryl would want assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl is currently under pressure and is receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is stressed but open to support, and that Maria can usefully assist her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and willing to help
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the outreach project

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl for a leadership role, the team leader supports it, and Cheryl accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has benefited from support and is capable, but she has not yet framed Cheryl as ready for leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria sees Cheryl's improved responsibility and confidence, and Cheryl willingly accepts the leadership role with team support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready, willing, and suitable to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and continue advocating for her

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl tells Maria she was surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that her suggestion might have overstepped or made Cheryl feel pressured, despite believing Cheryl is capable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl does not feel pressured and instead values Maria's support and confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes her suggestion was welcomed and that Cheryl feels supported rather than overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain open communication with Cheryl and continue supporting her without pressure

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl responds enthusiastically to Maria's proposal that they co-lead the project together, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and believes they collaborate well together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl wants to co-lead and sees their partnership as valuable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes co-leading the project with Cheryl will be mutually supportive and effective.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Cheryl says she would love to team up for more future projects and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and that they have strong synergy as a team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Maria learns Cheryl is enthusiastic about continuing their partnership on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes they should keep teaming up and that their future collaboration is promising.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future
